operating_sensitivities.ranking_metric: maximum absolute per-share effect across each symmetric low/high range; depends on economic shock width
operating_sensitivities.range_basis: Sales +/-1pp then +/-2pp tests demand uncertainty; merchandise cost +/-1pp then +/-0.5pp tests margin; SG&A +/-0.5pp then +/-1pp tests wage/fulfillment pressure; capex +/-1pp then +/-0.5pp tests investment policy. These are explicit stress assumptions, not statistical intervals.
operating_sensitivities.interpretation: Changing relative range widths can change rankings; simply halving every shock is not an independent range-robustness argument.

combined_stress_envelope.interpretation: Combined operating/WACC/growth stress, not a probability interval; ranges are chosen modeling assumptions.
